sloka: स पृष्टो राजपुत्रेण रामेणामिततेजसा।आचचक्षे महातेजा राघवाय विभीषणः ।। ६.७१.२६ ।।
transliteration: sa pṛṣṭo rājaputreṇa rāmeṇāmitatejasā।ācacakṣe mahātejā rāghavāya vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.71.26 ।।

translations.english: Interrogated by the highly brilliant prince Raghava, energetic Vibheeshana revealed.
